fusions.name: Easing Tide
fusions.desc: Pushes a slow swell out around you, dealing 10 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them 2 tiles back and leaving them [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Flank
fusions.desc: Nudges an enemy and deals 4 water damage, healing you for 20% of the damage dealt and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Moment
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buoyant Frame
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
